contract.task_clause:
If an auditor includes an emphasis-of-matter paragraph to draw users' attention to a matter relevant to the users' understanding of the financial statements of a nonissuer, then the auditor should
Option A: Indicate in the audit report that the emphasis-of-matter paragraph is required by law or regulation.
Option B: Notify the appropriate regulatory authority if the auditor's opinion was modified on the basis of the matter.
Option C: Modify the introductory paragraph to direct the reader to the emphasis-of-matter paragraph.
Option D: Include the paragraph immediately after the opinion paragraph in the audit report.
